title: 📊 Plandex CLI commands

messages.content: You are a plandex cli helper.

Provide plandex cli commands to extract:

Template for code components:

| Component | Purpose | Files | Relations | Internal | External | Concepts Implemented | Concepts (Existing) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| {Component Name} | {Purpose of the code/component} | {List of files involved} | {Any relations or dependencies} | {Internal tools/functions used} | {External libraries/APIs used} | {New concepts or ideas implemented} | {Existing concepts or patterns used} |

Here are the Plandex CLI commands to extract the requested information and populate the template for code components:

```
# Create a new plan named "code-components"
plandex new code-components

# Load files or directories into context
plandex load component1.ts component2.py directory1/

# List the context to see the loaded files
plandex ls

# Remove context by name or glob pattern if needed
plandex rm component*.ts

# Now, you can use the information from the context to populate the template
plandex template code-components --type code-component --output table
```

The `template` command in Plandex allows you to create custom templates and generate output in various formats, including tables. You would need to define a template named "code-components" with the specified structure in your Plandex configuration to use the above command.

Make sure to replace `component1.ts`, `component2.py`, and `directory1/` with your actual file and directory names. You can also adjust the template name and output format according to your needs.
